fields.why: The headline claim is a period case count (38) against an expected count (3, 5-year median), which reads as incidence (count/rate); the brief's 'counts and proportions' under binary/categorical also lets A's reading stand. Count/rate is slightly preferred because the claim rests on case counts over time vs a baseline.

brief_issues: Brief lists 'counts' under binary/categorical and 'incidence' under count/rate; it should say whether unmodelled case counts per period (vs an expected/baseline count) are count/rate.
